hero.title: A modern Nuxt starter for global product teams
hero.description: A modular Nuxt 4 foundation with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, i18n, auth, a service-first API layer, and a clean docs experience.
hero.note: Built to stay clean for teams that want to ship real features fast.

landing.featuresTitle: Everything the starter already gives you
landing.featuresDescription: The template is intentionally opinionated around the pieces that matter in production.

api.title: Service-first API access
api.description: All data access flows through useApi() and feature services so components stay thin.

modules.title: Domain-driven modules
modules.description: Each feature owns its pages, components, services, and types inside a self-contained folder.

forms.title: Typed validation flows
forms.description: Forms use vee-validate and zod so state, rules, and submissions stay explicit.

theme.title: Theme-aware UI
theme.description: Semantic tokens and Tailwind utilities keep light and dark modes aligned.

i18n.title: Locale-ready content
i18n.description: Shared and module messages are wired for English and Arabic from the start.

auth.title: Opt-in page middleware
auth.description: Protected pages use page-level middleware instead of hidden global assumptions.

seo.title: SEO-ready pages
seo.description: Per-page metadata and layout structure make routes easy to optimize.

testing.title: Testing-friendly structure
testing.description: Vitest and the starter conventions make targeted checks straightforward.

landing.architectureDescription: The starter keeps concerns separate so teams can grow the app without reworking the foundation.

core.title: app/core
core.description: Shared utilities, API client, composables, config, and app-wide helpers.

modules.title: app/modules
modules.description: Feature modules own their feature-specific pages, services, types, and UI.

pages.title: app/pages
pages.description: Public routes compose the presentation layer and direct users into the right feature.

layouts.title: app/layouts
layouts.description: Default, auth, and blank shells keep route chrome predictable.

landing.stackDescription: The starter is tuned for a balanced production baseline rather than a toy demo.

serviceFirst.title: Service first
serviceFirst.description: Compose features from services, then keep UI focused on rendering and interaction.

localeAware.title: Locale aware
localeAware.description: Shared messages and module messages are merged before the app renders, so copy stays consistent.

landing.ctaTitle: Ready to explore the structure in more detail?
landing.ctaDescription: Open the showcase route for a deeper tour of the folder structure, patterns, and page-level conventions.

hero.title: A practical guide to using the starter in real work
hero.description: This route shows how the starter is applied in practice: routes, services, forms, localization, and the page shell conventions that keep the system consistent.

routes.title: Public routes
routes.description: Home, docs, showcase, dashboard, and auth shells are separated by purpose.

rules.title: Route rules
rules.description: Page-level metadata and RTL-safe utilities keep the starter consistent.

example.structureDescription: The starter is organized around clear ownership boundaries so each layer stays easy to reason about.

core.label: Core
core.description: Shared services, composables, utilities, and configuration live in one place.

modules.label: Modules
modules.description: Feature-specific logic stays isolated in its own module folder.

pages.label: Pages
pages.description: Routes are composed from page files and can be protected per route.

layouts.label: Layouts
layouts.description: Route shells stay simple with default, auth, and blank layout modes.

example.principlesDescription: The starter favors a narrow set of rules that keep features predictable as the app grows.

serviceFirst.title: Service-first data access
serviceFirst.description: Components call module services, and services wrap the shared API layer.

typedData.title: Typed data flows
typedData.description: API responses, form values, and component props stay typed end to end.

pageMeta.title: Per-page metadata
pageMeta.description: Every page sets its own title and can add route-specific SEO later.

rtl.title: RTL-friendly styling
rtl.description: Tailwind start/end utilities keep Arabic layouts aligned automatically.

i18n.title: Locale-aware UI text
i18n.description: Shared and module messages are merged into one locale-aware experience.

theme.title: Semantic theming
theme.description: Color tokens and utility classes keep the UI consistent in both themes.

example.usageDescription: Use the starter conventions to ship predictable routes, services, and UI surfaces.
example.runtimeDescription: Shared messages, locale routing, and theme controls stay in the app shell rather than inside feature code.
example.routesDescription: The starter uses the public surface to explain the system before a team starts adding product-specific screens.

home.title: Home
home.description: The landing page presents the starter and points to the deeper showcase.

showcase.title: Showcase
showcase.description: A docs-style route that walks through the structure and conventions.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: A protected example of how a real product route can use the default layout.

auth.title: Auth layouts
auth.description: Login and registration flows belong in the auth shell, not the public shell.

example.ctaTitle: Use this as the starting point for production work
example.ctaDescription: Keep the same structure, then swap the showcase copy for your product-specific modules and endpoints.
